title: Investors give your deck under 3 minutes

beats.text: Investors spend under three minutes on your pitch deck.
Decks that didn't raise got ninety seconds. Decks that raised? Over four minutes.
Make these three slides impossible to skip.

beats.label: TRACTION
beats.text: One. Traction. One chart. Up and to the right.

beats.label: TEAM
beats.text: Two. Team. Why you, in one line.

beats.label: MARKET
beats.text: Three. Market. How big, with a source. Not a guess.
If they have to search for your numbers, you've lost them.
Save this before your next pitch.
